installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SPT Server Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
SPT_URL="https://github.com/sp-tarkov/server"
FIKA_URL="https://github.com/project-fika/Fika-Server"
 
printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Downloading installation dependencies..."
apt -q update
apt -q install -y git curl git-lfs

cd /mnt/server

# Remove old folders
printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Cleaning up old folders if they exist."
rm -rvf /mnt/server/*_Data /mnt/server/SPT.Server /mnt/server/user/mods/fika-server /mnt/server/user/mods/[Cc]orter-[Mm]od[Ss]ync

# Download SPT server build files
mkdir -p /mnt/server/tmp
printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Downloading SPT..."
if [[ ${SPT_ADVANCED} -eq 0 ]]; then
  git clone $SPT_URL /mnt/server/tmp
  cd /mnt/server/tmp
  if [[ -n ${SPT_TAG} ]]; then
    git checkout -q --progress tags/$SPT_TAG
  fi
else
  git clone --branch $SPT_BRANCH $SPT_URL /mnt/server/tmp
  cd /mnt/server/tmp
  if [[ -n ${SPT_COMMIT} ]]; then
    git checkout -q --progress $SPT_COMMIT
  fi
fi
git-lfs fetch --all
git-lfs pull
printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Download done."

cd /mnt/server/tmp/project

# Install NodeJS in builder
printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Downloading required node version..."
curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/master/install.sh | bash
source ~/.bashrc
nvm install
 
# Build SPT server
printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Installing build requirements..."
node --max-old-space-size=4096 $(which npm) install
printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Building SPT Server..."
node --max-old-space-size=4096 $(which npm) run build:release

# Move server to definitive folder
printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Transfering built files to server root."
cd /mnt/server
mv /mnt/server/tmp/project/build/* /mnt/server
SPT_EXE=$(ls /mnt/server/ | grep .exe)
mv /mnt/server/$SPT_EXE /mnt/server/SPT.Server

# Clean up the build files
printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Cleaning up ..."
rm -rf /mnt/server/tmp # Remove SPT build files

# Download Fika
printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Downloading Fika..."
cd /mnt/server
if [[ ${SPT_ADVANCED} -eq 0 ]]; then
  GIT_API_LINK="https://api.github.com/repos/project-fika/Fika-Server/releases/tags/${FIKA_VERSION}"
  DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(curl -sSL ${GIT_API_LINK} | jq -r '.assets[].browser_download_url|select(match("fika-server"))')
  curl -L "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" -o "${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}"
  unzip -q ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}
  rm -rf ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}
else
  mkdir -p /mnt/server/tmp
  git clone --branch ${FIKA_BRANCH} ${FIKA_URL} /mnt/server/tmp
  cd /mnt/server/tmp
  if [[ -n ${FIKA_COMMIT} ]]; then
    git checkout -q --progress $FIKA_COMMIT
  fi
  printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Building Fika..."
  npm i --include=dev
  npm run build
  cd /mnt/server
  mv /mnt/server/tmp/dist/fika-server.zip /mnt/server
  unzip -q fika-server.zip
  rm -rf /mnt/server/tmp /mnt/server/fika-server.zip
fi

# Download ModSync
printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Downloading ModSync..."
cd /mnt/server
GIT_API_LINK="https://api.github.com/repos/c-orter/modsync/releases/tags/${MODSYNC_VERSION}"
DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(curl -sSL ${GIT_API_LINK} | jq -r '.assets[].browser_download_url|select(match("ModSync"; "i"))')
curl -L "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" -o "${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}"
unzip -q ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}
rm -rf ${DOWNLOAD_LINK##*/}

printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Creating ModSync default folders..."
mkdir -vp BepInEx/{plugins,patchers,config}

# Set files permissions (might not work if not done)
chmod o+rwx /mnt/server -R

printf "\033[1m\033[33mcontainer@pterodactyl~ \033[0m%s\n" "Install complete."
exit 0
